# Recorded sounds

Four sounds are built from recordings, not synthesised: the flat's door opening, the car door opening, the starter
cranking and the engine dying (`door_open()`, `car_door_open()`, `starter_crank()` and `engine_sputter()` in
`tools/gen_audio.py`, which cuts, filters and levels them). Each file here is a mono 16-bit 44.1 kHz excerpt of the
recording, taken from the site's full-length 320 kbps MP3. The recordings are by Joseph Sardin, BigSoundBank, released
under CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://bigsoundbank.com/licenses.html. Fetched 2026-11-08.

## bsb-1702-apartment-door-opening.wav

Apartment Door, Opening #1 (no. 1702): "Opening of a Parisian apartment door. Grinding." 0.0 to 2.3 s.
URL: https://bigsoundbank.com/apartment-door-opening-1-s1702.html

## bsb-1526-car-door.wav

Car door #4 (no. 1526): "Opening and closing a Peugeot 107 door. Sound outside the car." 0.0 to 1.25 s (the opening).
URL: https://bigsoundbank.com/car-door-4-s1526.html

## bsb-0872-car-difficult-start.wav

Car: Difficult Start (no. 0872): "Hard starting a car. Is a Peugeot 106." 0.1 to 3.4 s (the first try, which fails).

## bsb-1571-damaged-muffler.wav

Damaged muffler 3, parked car (no. 1571): "A car with a damaged muffler. Parked car. Starting the engine. Stopping the
engine." 13.0 to 16.25 s (its idle, its last cough and its stop).
URL: https://bigsoundbank.com/damaged-muffler-3-parked-car-s1571.html
